ideas.name: Google Search attention weekly large-cap picking
ideas.claim: Buy US large caps with low search attention, rebalanced weekly.
ideas.quote: This alternative data strategy seeks to buy stocks with low attention attached to them.

rules.entry: long stocks with low Google Search attention

ideas.name: Technology momentum patent-linked long-short
ideas.claim: Stocks linked to technological innovation with positive momentum are mispriced; long-short monthly.
ideas.quote: Investors tend to misvalue innovation or undervalue innovative efficiency and originality.

rules.entry: long-short on technology-linked returns (incl. new patent counts)

ideas.name: Lexical density of filings long-short
ideas.claim: Long stocks whose filings have many information-carrying words, short the rest, monthly.
ideas.quote: Long stocks with large amount of information-carrying words in their company filings.

rules.entry: long high lexical density, short low
